title: Spring constant calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates spring constant k = 250 N/m using Hooke's Law with given spring force and elongation.

title: Friction on block A
description: Essential: Correctly identifies static friction force on A as 5√3 N from equilibrium with rope tension.

title: Ground friction on B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates ground friction on B as 2.5√3 N from horizontal force balance.

title: Force equilibrium for C
description: Important: Applies equilibrium conditions to ball C with proper vector decomposition of spring and rope forces.

title: Horizontal balance for B
description: Important: Recognizes that ground friction balances horizontal components of forces from pulley connections.

title: Angle application
description: Important: Correctly uses given 30° and 60° angles with trigonometric functions in force decompositions.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout (N, m, kg) and converts cm to m for spring elongation.

title: Sign/direction errors
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns directions to friction forces or misinterprets which surface exerts friction on which object.

title: Trigonometric mistakes
description: Pitfall: Confuses sine/cosine for given angles or incorrectly decomposes forces into components.
